TrainYAS Ladies

Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates · Yas Island · Open streets · Road · Social

Women / trans / femme

TrainYAS Ladies is an open-streets program in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates: streets closed to cars and open to bikes. It runs every Tuesday from 6:00 pm local time. Pace: your own pace; cyclists ride anti-clockwise.

For visitors

Women only. Register online for a TrainYAS barcode and show it at the gate. Helmet and closed shoes compulsory. Free loan bikes in adult sizes, first come first served.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: your own pace; cyclists ride anti-clockwise.
Check
Look at @ymcofficial the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the TrainYAS Ladies group ride

A women-only evening on the Yas Marina Formula 1 circuit, for cyclists, runners and walkers. Ride laps at your own pace on closed tarmac. Loan bikes are available.
